question: What condition of consecration requires corrective ritual attention for a Śiva linga?
premises: The object may be a Śiva linga or similar item.
It may have been consecrated by an ignorant person.
Such consecration is treated as a special case.
inference: A Śiva linga or similar object consecrated by an ignorant person requires correction.
plain_english: Whatever object, such as a Śiva linga, has been consecrated by an ignorant person—
